definitions.gloss: dark ink; thick, deep-black sumi ink
definitions.explanation: Sumi ink ground to a deep, dark black, as opposed to {薄墨|うすずみ} (pale, watered-down ink). Used in calligraphy and traditional writing, and standard for congratulatory or formal correspondence.

examples.japanese: {濃墨|こずみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write the name in dark ink.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃墨|こずみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{礼儀|れいぎ}→礼儀：03780_reigi⟧だ。
examples.english: It is proper etiquette to write congratulatory letters in dark ink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{力強|ちからづよ}い→力強い：03119_chikarazuyoi⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃墨|こずみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The calligraphy teacher said that dark ink is essential for powerful strokes.

notes:
The counterpart of ⟦{薄墨|うすずみ}→薄墨：29763_usuzumi⟧ (pale ink). In traditional correspondence the depth of the ink carries meaning: deep black ink is used for happy or formal occasions, while pale ink signals mourning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃墨|こずみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in dark ink
- {濃墨|こずみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{磨|す}る: to grind (make) dark ink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薄墨|うすずみ}→薄墨：29763_usuzumi⟧: pale ink — watered-down gray ink, used for condolence letters.
- ⟦{墨汁|ぼくじゅう}→墨汁：17748_bokujuu⟧: liquid sumi ink — ready-made bottled ink, as opposed to ink ground from an inkstick.
